newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: IMF says Venezuela 30 pct inflation feasible-Matos.
newsitem.headline: IMF says Venezuela 30 pct inflation feasible-Matos.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund considers Venezuela's 1997 inflation target of 30 percent attainable, provided a tight rein is kept on fiscal accounts, Venezuela's Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos Azocar said Wednesday.

"The Fund thinks it (the 30 percent inflation target) is a goal which we can achieve if we maintain fiscal discipline," Matos said in a Finance Ministry statement of comments he made via telephone from Washington.
Matos spoke after a meeting with IMF Managing Director Michel Camdessus. Matos said Camdessus told him the IMF would extend its stand-by program with Venezuela for another 18 months.

Earlier this month, Camdessus expressed concern at wage pressure in Venezuela and urged the government to keep a lid on spending to avoid jeopardizing its goal of slashing inflation from 103.2 percent in 1996.
